newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat eases as growers take the price.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat eases as growers take the price.

text.p: Australian wheat futures edged back on Tuesday, against Chicago's stronger trend, as growers took price gains offered by the recently-rising market.
January 1998 was the only contract to trade, with six lots going through at A$188.00 a tonne, down A$1.00 on the trade.
Settlement prices were mixed, with falls outnumbering rises by about two to one. Price declines were between 50 cents and A$3.50 a tonne, while gains were A$1.50 to A$3.00.
"Farmers are starting to recognise good levels to sell and that's why settlement prices have drifted off," said Chris Gray of Bell Commodities.
